rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a sandy or pebbly beach.

example.english: We went to the beach for a swim today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 jau4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for a shore understood as a shoal or tidal flat rather than the all-purpose 沙灘.

example.english: When the tide went out, there were lots of oyster shells on the beach.
example.traditional: 潮退咗，灘上面有好多蠔殼。
example.jyutping: ciu4 teoi3 zo2 taan1 soeng6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 hou4 hok3
